output_json.diff_review: patch_only.diff touches only src/main/java/com/diffplug/gradle/eclipserunner/launcher/Main.java. It captures cacheDir = splash (configArea/PLUGIN_ID/<jar-name>) before appending the attacker-controlled jarEntry, then requires splash.getCanonicalPath() to start with cacheDir.getCanonicalPath()+File.separator, returning null (logged) otherwise. IOException during canonicalization is caught and returns null, matching the existing null-return contract the caller already handles. Canonicalization collapses ../ and symlink components, so the guard sits before the exists-check, directory creation, and Files.copy — nothing is written on a traversal. Legitimate entries (splash.bmp, nl/xx/splash.bmp) resolve inside cacheDir and are unaffected. The change is minimal, targeted at the vulnerable sink, and does not remove functionality or touch the POV. pov.diff only adds the harness/runner and is untouched by the fix.
output_json.pov_result: Reran `bash .security-pipeline/pov/run_pov.sh` via the Docker wrapper on the patched worktree: output "extractFromJAR result = null ... SAFE: no file was written outside the config area (traversal blocked)." exit 1. Matches orchestrator's pov_after_patch. Before the patch the same POV wrote <work>/ESCAPED/pwned.txt with payload and printed VULNERABLE (exit 0). The POV exercises the real private getLibraryFromFragment/extractFromJAR via reflection and was not altered by the patch.
output_json.regression_result: Reran the focused JDK-8 compile of the three self-contained launcher classes (Main.java, JNIBridge.java, Constants.java) via the Docker wrapper: COMPILE_OK, exit 0. Confirms the patched source compiles cleanly.
output_json.summary: The patch adds a minimal canonical-path containment check in Main.extractFromJAR that confines the resolved extraction destination to the per-JAR cache directory, fixing the CWE-022 Zip-Slip. POV no longer reproduces (SAFE, exit 1), and the launcher sources still compile under JDK 8. Accepting.
